_doc: A druggist's bottle (#805; refs experiments/prop_lab/refs/doctor/): an aqua glass prescription panel bottle (4 oz), a flat front with its paper label, a cork. A prop that shatters (GlassProp): thin glass, so a ball, a fall off a shelf (3.2 m/s) or 40 kPa breaks it and what's in it goes on the floor. Four labels in the period's style (TINCT. OPII, TINCT. ARNICAE, SYR. IPECAC., TINCT. FERRI CHLOR.): the Nth made wears label N mod 4 (`variants`). Drawn from glb:medicine_bottles (tools/blender/props/doctor_d2.py): the glass the kit's `glass:` look, the labels printed (pbr:medicine_labels), the cork and contents baked the gun way. Written by tools/props/doctor.py.
